usage: - Commonly used for the activity of running, jogging, or going for a run. It is a very natural everyday word in Hong Kong Cantonese.
- Often appears after verbs like 去 or 做, for example when talking about going out to run or doing running as exercise.
- Good for fitness, exercise, and sports contexts. It can refer to casual jogging or more serious training, depending on context.
- This is a neutral, standard word and is easy for beginners to use in daily conversation about exercise routines.
